error[ZBX-E0561]: the Google credentials file cannot be read
  cause  GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS (/home/ci/gcp.json) can't be read, or is
         larger than 16384 bytes
  var    GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  max    16384 bytes
  fix    check that the file exists and is readable by this user
  more   zbx explain E0561
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0561.html
